productDetails.Warning2: Prolonged use may also occasionally result in overgrowth of non-susceptible organisms.
productDetails.Warning3: In patients with renal impairment, Co-Amoxiclav dosage should be adjusted as recommended.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Mycophenolate mofetil , Probenecid , Oral contraceptives , acenocoumarol or warfarin .

productDetails.HowItWorks: Because it contains iron in the form of folic acid, this medication is often used to make up for iron shortages. Only a very small amount of vitamins are required by our body, but if this tiny requirement is met, our body’s immunity improves greatly.
productDetails.Generics: It contains vitamin A, vitamin B1, vitamin B2, vitamin B6, vitamin B12, vitamin C,vitamin D, vitamin E, nicotinamide, biotin, calcium, folic acid, iron, iodine, magnesium, manganese, pantothenic acid, potassium, phosphorus, zinc.
productDetails.Indication: Vitrum multivitamin tablet is intended to address vitamin and mineral deficiencies that can happen as a result of unhealthy dietary practices. The following uses are for Vitrum Tablet: It helps in developing and building muscles. It helps in increasing immunity. It helps in fostering growth. It helps in enhancing muscular strength.
productDetails.SideEffects: You could experience diarrhea, constipation, or a stomachache. These side effects are typically transient and can go away as your body becomes used to the medicine. Inform your doctor or pharmacist as soon as possible if any of these side effects persist or get worse.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Inform your doctor or pharmacist before using this medication if you have any allergies to any of its ingredients, to soy or peanuts (which are present in some brands), or to any other substances.
productDetails.Dosage: Take this drug by mouth as instructed, often once a day. Follow all the instructions on the product’s packaging or do what your doctor advises.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: Tell your doctor before taking your multivitamin if it contains folic acid and you suffer from pernicious anemia or vitamin B12 deficiency. Without addressing this anemia, folic acid may have an impact on several laboratory tests for vitamin B12 deficiency.
productDetails.Warning1: Inactive chemicals in this product have the potential to trigger allergic reactions or other issues. To learn more, speak with your doctor.
productDetails.Warning2: Inform your doctor or pharmacist about your medical history before using this drug, especially of: alcohol use or abuse, liver problems, stomach/intestinal disorders (such as ulcer, colitis).
productDetails.Warning3: Serious nerve issues could arise from vitamin B12 deficiency if left untreated, such as peripheral neuropathy.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Consult your physician or pharmacist in case of any drug interaction .

productDetails.HowItWorks: Nebivolol is a ß1 selective adrenoceptor antagonist whose hemodynamic effects differ from those of classical ß-adrenoceptor antagonist as a result of a vasodilating action. It has mild vasodilating properties attributed to its interaction with the L-arginine/nitric oxide path way, a property not shared by other ß-blockers. Nebivolol lacks intrinsic sympathomimetic and membrane stabilizing activity at therapeutically relevant concentrations. At clinically relevant doses, nebivolol does not demonstrate a1-adrenergic receptor blockade activity.
productDetails.Indication: For the treatment of essential hypertension, stable, mild and moderate chronic heart failure in addition to standard therapies in elderly patients 70 years and may be used alone or in combination with other anti-hypertensive agents.
productDetails.SideEffects: Common: Headache, dizziness, paresthesia, dyspnea, constipation, nausea, diarrhea, tiredness, edema.Uncommon: Nightmares, depression, impaired vision, bradycardia, heart failure, slowed AV conduction/AV-block, hypotension, (increase of) intermittent claudication, bronchospasm, dyspepsia, flatulence, vomiting, pruritus, rash, erythematous, impotence.Rare: Syncope, psoriasis aggravated.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Nebivolol is contraindicated in patients with:- Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the components.- Severe hepatic insufficiency.- Acute heart failure, cardiogenic shock or episodes of heart failure decompensation requiring I.V. inotropic therapy.- Sick sinus syndrome, including sino-atrial block.- Second and third degree heart block (without a pacemaker).- History of bronchospasm and bronchial asthma.- Untreated phaeochromocytoma.- Metabolic acidosis.- Bradycardia (heart rate < 60bpm prior to start of therapy).- Hypotension (systoli c blood pressure < 90mmHg).- Severe peripheral circulatory disturbances.
productDetails.Dosage: Hypertension - Adults : The dose is one tablet (5mg) daily, preferably at the same time of the day. Tablets may be taken with or without meals. The initial up titration should be done at 1-2 weekly intervals based on patient tolerability. The maximum recommended dose is 10mg nebivolol once daily . Elderly : In patients over 65 years, the recommended starting dose is 2.5mg daily. If needed, the daily dose may be increased to 5mg. Children : Not recommended. Or As directed by your physician.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: In patients who have compensated congestive heart failure, nebivolol should be administered cautiously. If heart failure worsens, discontinuation of nebivolol should be considered.
productDetails.Warning1: Care should be taken in diabetic patients however, as nebivolol may mask certain symptoms of hypoglycemia (tachycardia, palpitations). ß-adrenergic blocking agents may mask tachycardic symptoms in hyperthyroidism. Abrupt withdrawal may intensify symptoms.
productDetails.Warning2: The treatment with nebivolol is not recommended to be stopped abruptly since this might lead to a transitory worsening of heart failure. If discontinuation is necessary, the dose should be gradually decreaseddivided into halves weekly. If the angina worsens or acute coronary insufficiency develops, it is recommended that nebivolol be promptly reinstituted, at least temporarily.
productDetails.Warning3: ß-blockers can precipitate or aggravate symptoms of arterial insufficiency in patients with peripheral vascular diseases. Caution should be exercised in these patients.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Phenylalkylamine [verapamil] and benzothiazepine [diltiazem] classes) or antiarrhythmic agents such as disopyramide , digitalis glycosides and ß-blockers , reserpine or guanethidine , clonidine , CYP2D6 inhibitors (quinidine, propafenone, fluoxetine, paroxetine ) , Cimetidine , Sildenafil.

productDetails.HowItWorks: It is a selective antagonist at dopamine ( D2) receptors . It exerts a regulation action both on the central and peripheral nervous circuits controlling the dynamics of digestive system.
productDetails.Indication: Levosulpiride (25mg) is indicated for : Gastroesophagal Reflux Disease , Irritable bowel syndrome . Levosulpiride ( 50mg ) is indicated for Schizophrenia , endogenous and reactive suppressive states.
productDetails.SideEffects: Sleep disturbances , over stimulation , and agitation . Extrapyramidal effects. Cardiovascular effects, hypotension.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Levosulpiride should not be taken if you are allergic to it. Levosulpiride is not recommended if you have epilepsy (brain disorder with abnormal brain activity), bipolar disorder (a mental disorder with mood shifts), breast cancer, or bleeding in the stomach and intestine. Inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney, or other problems. Inform your doctor if you are taking any other herbs and medicines.
productDetails.Dosage: Adults : GERD or IBS : 1 Tablet of 25mg 3 times a day. Endogenous and reactive depressive states : 2-3 tablets 50mg a day ; Acute and chronic Schizophrenia : 4-6 tablets of 50mg a day . Children : 3-5mg/kg daily to children over 14 yr of age . Tourette's Syndrome : Adolescents : 14-18 yr , 200-400mg twice daily . OR As directed by your physician.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: Bipolar disorder is a mood disorder associated with episodes of mood swings ranging from depressive lows to manic highs. Levosulpiride is not recommended for use if you have bipolar disorder, as it can trigger manic episodes.
productDetails.Warning1: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder in which nerve cell activity in your brain is disturbed, causing seizures. Levosulpiride is not recommended for use if you have epilepsy as this medicine can trigger seizures.
productDetails.Warning2: Breast cancer is a type of cancer occurring in the cells of breasts. Levosulpiride increases the levels of the prolactin hormone in your body. This can worsen breast cancer. Hence this medicine is not recommended for use if you have breast cancer.
productDetails.Warning3: Levosulpiride has to be used with caution in elderly people as the risk of side effects is high. Your doctor will choose the correct dose of the medicine for you after assessing you clinically.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Alcohol , CNS depressants , guanethidine , anticholinergics , antacids , NSAIDs.

productDetails.HowItWorks: Fexofenadine HCl : Fexofenadine hydrochloride is an active non-sedating antihistamine with selective H1-receptor activity. It does not possess significant sedative or antimuscarinic actions.Pseudoephedrine HCl : Pseudoephedrine hydrochloride exerts a decongestant action on the nasal mucosa. Pseudoephedrine produces peripheral effects similar to those of ephedrine and central effects similarto, but less intense than, amphetamines.
productDetails.Indication: It is indicated for the relief of symptoms of allergic rhinitis with nasal congestion, in adults and children 12 years of age and older, when both the anti-allergic properties of fexofenadine HCl and the decongestant activity of pseudoephedrine HCl are required.
productDetails.SideEffects: Headache, insomnia, nausea, dry mouth, dyspepsia, throat irritation, dizziness, agitation, back pain, palpitation, nervousness, anxiety, upper respiratory infection, abdominal pain.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Fexofenadine HCl + Pseudoephedrine HCl is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any of its ingredients. Due to its pseudoephedrine component, Fexofenadine HCl + Pseudoephedrine HCl is contraindicated : • In patients with narrow-angle glaucoma or urinary retention.• In patients receiving monoamine oxidase (MAO) inhibitor therapy or within fourteen (14) days of stopping such treatment.• In patients with severe hypertension, or severe coronary artery disease, and in those who have shown idiosyncrasy to its components, to adrenergic agents, or to other drugs of similar chemical structures.

productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: Safety and effectiveness in children below the age of 12 years have not been established. It is not recommended for pediatric patients under 12 years of age.
productDetails.Warning1: Sympathomimetic amines (like pseudoephedrine) should be used with caution in patients with hypertension, diabetes mellitus, ischemic heart disease, increased intraocular pressure, hyperthyroidism, renal impairment, or prostatic hypertrophy.
productDetails.Warning2: There are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women with this medicine , therefore, it should be used during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies the potential risk to the fetus.
productDetails.Warning3: Caution should be exercised when it is administered to nursing women, as pseudoephedrine is excreted in human breast milk.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: The concurrent use of these tablets with over-the-counter antihistamines and decongestants should be avoided. It should not be taken closely in time with aluminum and magnesium containing antacids.

Debate exists about its primary site of action, which may be inhibition of prostaglandin (PG) synthesis or through an active metabolite influencing cannabinoid receptors.

productDetails.DrugInteractions: The anticoagulant effect of warfarin and other coumarins may be enhanced by prolonged regular daily use of paracetamol with increased risk of bleeding; occasional doses have no significant effect.

productDetails.HowItWorks: It works by affecting the body's response to some nerve impulses, especially in the heart. As a result, it decreases the heart's need for blood and oxygen and therefore reduces the amount of work the heart has to do. It also widens the blood vessels in the body, as well as helping the heart to beat more regularly.
productDetails.Indication: It is used to treat or prevent a number of conditions, most of which are related to the heart. • To lower high blood pressure, also called hypertension • To prevent angina.
productDetails.SideEffects: • Nausea (feeling sick), vomiting • loss of appetite • diarrhoea, stomach pain, flatulence • cold hands or feet • dizziness, tiredness • rash • flushing • hair loss • feeling tired, lethargic, lack of energy • disturbed sleep, vivid dreams or nightmares • conjunctivitis, dry eyes • visual disturbances • trouble passing urine • unexplained bruising • mood changes, confusion • sexual problems • loss of hearing • slow heart beats.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Do not take propranolol if you have an allergy to: • Propranolol • Any of the ingredient listed • Any other similar medicines such as beta-blockers .
productDetails.Dosage: Adults : Adjust dosage according to response in divided doses. Hypertension : Usually 160-320mg daily. Angina pectoris : Usually 120-240mg daily.Arrthymias : 10-40 mg three to four times daily . Anxiety . migraine , essential tremor : Usually 80-160mg daily. Children : Not recommended. Always consult your doctor or pharmacist for dose adjustments.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: It is severely toxic if you take too much. Taking too much causes difficulty in breathing, lightheadedness or dizziness, feeling very tired, fits, slowed heart beat or coma.
productDetails.Warning1: Do not take propranolol if you have asthma or severe breathing problems. Taking propranolol may make these conditions worse.
productDetails.Warning2: Do not take propranolol if you have certain other heart problems for example heart failure, low blood pressure, problems with your circulation, Prinzmetal's angina, or a slow heart beat. Taking propranolol may make these conditions worse.
productDetails.Warning3: Do not take propranolol if you have low blood sugar levels. Taking propranolol may make these conditions worse.

productDetails.HowItWorks: Amlodipine and Valsartan are antihypertensive compounds with complementary mechanisms to control blood pressure in patients with essential hypertension. The combination of these substances has an additive antihypertensive effect, reducing blood pressure to a greater degree than either component alone.
productDetails.Indication: It is indicated for the treatment of Hypertension.
productDetails.SideEffects: Nasopharyngitis, influenza, hypokalemia, headache, asthenia, fatigue, facial edema, flushing, hot flush, edema, edema peripheral and pitting edema , Anorexia, hypercalcemia, hyperlipidemia, hyperuricemia, hyponatremia, coordination abnormal, dizziness, dizziness postural, paraesthesia, somnolence, visual impairment, vertigo, palpitations, tachycardia, orthostatic hypotension, cough, pharyngolaryngeal pain, abdominal discomfort, abdominal pain upper, constipation, diarrhea, dry mouth, nausea, erythema, rash, arthralgia, back pain and joint swelling.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: The combination of amlodipine and valsartan is contraindicated in: - Patients with known hypersensitivity to the active substances, to dihydropyridine derivatives or to any of the excipient of the product. Severe hepatic impairment, biliary cirrhosis or cholestasis.
productDetails.Dosage: Adults : The recommended dose of Amlodipine + Valsartan is one tablet per day. It can be used with or without food and it is recommended to take (Amlodipine + Valsartan) with some water. Children : Not recommended . Consult your doctor or Pharmacist for dose adjustment.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: Combination of amlodipine + valsartan should be used with caution to treat hypertension in patients with unilateral or bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis to a solitary kidney since blood urea and serum creatinine may increase in such patients.
productDetails.Warning1: Concomitant use with potassium supplements, potassium-sparing diuretics, salt substitutes containing potassium, or other medicinal products that may increase potassium levels (heparin, etc.) should be undertaken with caution and with frequent monitoring of potassium levels.
productDetails.Warning2: The safety and efficacy of amlodipine in hypertensive crisis have not been established.
productDetails.Warning3: Angioedema, including swelling of the larynx and glottis, causing airway obstruction and/or swelling of the face, lips, pharynx and/or tongue, has been reported in patients treated with valsartan. Combination of amlodipine + valsartan should be discontinued immediately in patients who develop angioedema and should not be re-administered.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Antihypertensive agents , grapefruit or grapefruit juice , CYP3A4 inhibitors (protease inhibitors, azole antifungals, macrolides like erythromycin or clarithromycin, verapamil or diltiazem) , CYP3A4 inducers (e.g. rifampicin, Hypericum perforatum) , Simvastatin , Lithium , Potassium-sparing diuretics, potassium supplements, salt substitutes containing potassium , NSAIDs , (rifampicin, cyclosporine) or efflux transporter (ritonavir) , Sildenafil.

productDetails.HowItWorks: It belongs to a group of medicines called an anthelmintic, these are medicines which bind to the nerve and muscle cells of parasites, resulting in their death.
productDetails.Indication: It is an antiparasitic medicine used to treat the following infection: • Treatment of intestinal strongyloidiasis. • Treatment of parasites in the blood or tissue caused by Wuchereria bancrofti. • Treatment of human scabies after prior treatment has failed.
productDetails.SideEffects: Allergic reactions If you have an allergic reaction see a doctor straight away. Other side effects: • Liver disease (acute hepatitis). • Changes in some laboratory tests (increase of liver enzymes, increase of bilirubin in blood, increase of eosinophils). • Blood in urine.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Do not take if: • You have an allergy to or any of the ingredients listed • The packaging is torn or shows signs of tampering • The expiry date on the pack has passed. If you take this medicine after the expiry date has passed, it may not work.

productDetails.HowItWorks: Esomeprazole works by binding irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase in the proton pump. Because the proton pump is the final pathway for secretion of hydrochloric acid by the parietal cells in the stomach, its inhibition dramatically decreases the secretion of hydrochloric acid into the stomach and alters gastric pH .

productDetails.SideEffects: Headache , GI upset , Skin reactions , Dry mouth. Rarely angioedema . Rarely angiooedema , anaphylaxis , fundic gland polyps.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: It is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to proton pump inhibitors (PPIs). Hypersensitivity reactions e.g. angioedema and anaphylaxis, bronchospasm, acute interstitial nephritis and urticaria have been reported with esomeprazole use.
productDetails.Dosage: Adults : GERD : For Adults : 20mg or 40mg once daily for 4 to 8 weeks. 12 to 17 years -- 20mg or 40mg once dailly for upto 8 weeks. Gastric Ulcers : 20mg or 40mg once daily for upto 6 months . Erosive oesophagitis : 40mg once daily for 4-8 wk . Prevention of relapse , 20mg once daily . Children : Not recommended . OR As directed by your physician .

productDetails.HowItWorks: Orlistat promotes weight loss by decreasing the amount of dietary fat absorbed in your intestines. Lipase, an enzyme found in the digestive tract, helps break down dietary fat into smaller components, so it can be used or stored for energy. Orlistat inhibits the work of lipase.
productDetails.Indication: It is used for weight loss.
productDetails.SideEffects: Faecal incontinence , oily stools , GI upsets , respiratory infection , influenza , headache , menstrual irregularity , anxiety , fatifue UTI. Vary rarely raised liver enzymes , hepatitis , rectal bleeding.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients, Chronic malabsorption syndrome ,  Cholestasis and Breast-feeding.
productDetails.Dosage: Adults : The recomeded dose of Orlistat is 1 capsule of 60mg or 120mg to be taken three times daily, immediately before, during or up to 1 hour after meals. If a meal is missed or contains no fat, the dose can be omitted. Not more than 3 capsules of 60mg or 120mg should be taken in 24 hours. It is recommended that the diet should be rich in fruits and vegetables. OR As directed by your physician.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: The decrease in bodyweight with Orlistat treatment is less in type II diabetic patients than in non-diabetic patients. Anti-diabetic medicinal product treatment may have to be closely monitored when taking Orlistat.
productDetails.Warning1: Patients should be advised to adhere to the dietary recommendations they are given.
productDetails.Warning2: Orlistat may unbalance anticonvulsant treatment by decreasing the absorption of antiepileptic drugs, leading to convulsions.
productDetails.Warning3: Rectal bleeding may be observed with Orlistat. Prescribers should investigate further in case of severe and/or persistent symptoms.

productDetails.DrugInteractions: Ciclosporin , Acarbose , Warfarin , Fat soluble vitamins , Amiodarone , Antiepileptic medicinal products , Levothyroxine , Antiretrovirals for HIV, antidepressants, antipsychotics and benzodiazepines .

productDetails.HowItWorks: Sildenafil works by improving the flow of blood into the male genital organ for sexual arousal and as a result, this helps in maintaining the erection.
productDetails.Indication: It is used for the treatment of erectile dysfunction (impotency) in men. It contains sildenafil. It is not meant for use in women, children & adolescents.
productDetails.SideEffects: Headache , Dizziness , Nausea , Indigestion , Stuffy nose .
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Do not use this medicine : If you are allergic to sildenafil or any other ingredients listed . If you suffer from any heart problems like stroke or heart attack or any liver problems. If you are taking certain medicines (nitrates) which can lead to a decrease in blood pressure . If you are taking riociguat which is used in the treatment of arterial blood pressure. If you have a certain eye condition like retinitis pigmentosa . If you have ever had a loss of vision .
productDetails.Dosage: As directed by your physician .
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: Women and patients less than 18 years old should not use Sildenafil Tablet.
productDetails.Warning1: Sildenafil Tablet is meant for use only in men.
productDetails.Warning2: Avoid driving if you feel dizzy or experience blurred vision after taking the Sildenafil Tablet .
productDetails.Warning3: Ask your doctor before using pengra if you have sickle cell anaemia.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Some medicines can affect the way the Sildenafil Tablet works or this medicine itself can reduce the effectiveness of other medicines taken at the same time. Tell your doctor about all the medicines, supplements or herbals you are currently taking or might take to avoid any possible interaction.

productDetails.HowItWorks: Antibiotics kill bacteria including the friendly ones in the stomach that are essential for digestion & food absorption. It restores the balance of friendly bacteria in intestines, increases absorption of nutrients by the body, and increases body's ability to resist microbial attacks.
productDetails.Indication: It is used for treating the alterations of the intestinal bacterial flora,it restores the equilibrium of the intestinal flora changed during diarrhoea or in the course of therapies with antibiotics or chemotherapy, contributing to correct the consequent dysvitaminosis (that is the imbalance of production and assimilation of the vitamins).
productDetails.SideEffects: Hypersensitivity reactions, including rash, urticaria and angioedema have been reported. Bacteremia, septicemia or sepsis in immunocompromised patients or those hospitalized due to a serious illness.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Hypersensitivity towards the components or other closely related substances.
productDetails.Dosage: Drops : Adults: from 2 to 3 mini bottles a day ; Children: from 1 to 2 mini bottles a day ; Infants: from 1 to 2 mini bottles a day . Tab : Adults : 2-3 tab daily. Caution: Do not exceed the indicated doses without the advice of the physician.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: During antibiotic therapy, the product should be administered in the interval between one dose of antibiotic and the next.
productDetails.Warning1: There have been reports of bacteremia, septicemia or sepsis in patients taking Bacillus clausii who are immunocompromised or are hospitalized due to a serious illness. It should be used in these patients only if the potential benefits outweigh the potential risks.
productDetails.Warning2: Use of probiotics in severe acute pancreatitis is contraindicated.
productDetails.Warning3: Excessive doses do not produce side effects. However, it is better to follow the recommended doses.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Ask your physician or pharmacist in case of any drug interactions.

productDetails.HowItWorks: Semaglutide is a GLP-1 analogue with 94% sequence homology to human GLP-1. Semaglutide acts as a GLP-1 receptor agonist that selectively binds to and activates the GLP-1 receptor, the target for native GLP-1. GLP-1 is a physiological hormone that has multiple actions on glucose, mediated by the GLP-1 receptors. The principal mechanism of protraction resulting in the long half-life of semaglutide is albumin binding, which results in decreased renal clearance and protection from metabolic degradation. Furthermore, semaglutide is stabilized against degradation by the DPP-4 enzyme. Semaglutide reduces blood glucose through a mechanism where it stimulates insulin secretion and lowers glucagon secretion, both in a glucose-dependent manner. Thus, when blood glucose is high, insulin secretion is stimulated and glucagon secretion is inhibited. The mechanism of blood glucose lowering also involves a minor delay in gastric emptying in the early postprandial phase.
productDetails.Indication: It is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus .
productDetails.SideEffects: Common: may affect up to 1 in 10 people : Complications of diabetic eye disease (retinopathy) – you should inform your doctor if you experience eye problems, such as changes in vision, during treatment with this medicine. Uncommon: may affect up to 1 in 100 people : Inflamed pancreas (acute pancreatitis) which could cause severe pain in the stomach and back which does not go away. You should see a doctor immediately if you experience such symptoms. Rare: may affect up to 1 in 1,000 people : Severe allergic reactions (anaphylactic reactions, angioedema). You should seek immediate medical help and inform your doctor straight away if you get symptoms such as breathing problems, swelling of face, lips, tongue and/or throat with difficulty swallowing and a fast heartbeat .
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: It is contraindicated in patients with: A personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or in patients with Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2) . Known hypersensitivity to semaglutide or to any of the product components .
productDetails.Dosage: Start it with a 0.25 mg subcutaneous injection once weekly for 4 weeks. The 0.25 mg dose is intended for treatment initiation and is not effective for glycemic control. After 4 weeks on the 0.25 mg dose, increase the dosage to 0.5 mg once weekly. If additional glycemic control is needed after at least 4 weeks on the 0.5 mg dose, the dosage may be increased to 1 mg once weekly. The maximum recommended dosage is 1 mg once weekly. Administer it once weekly, on the same day each week, at any time of the day, with or without meals. OR As directed by your physician .
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store in a refrigerator (2°C–8°C). Do not Freeze .
productDetails.Precautions: In patients with diabetic retinopathy treated with insulin and semaglutide, an increased risk of developing diabetic retinopathy complications has been observed . Caution should be exercised when using semaglutide in patients with diabetic retinopathy treated with insulin. These patients should be monitored closely and treated according to clinical guidelines. Rapid improvement in glucose control has been associated with a temporary worsening of diabetic retinopathy, but other mechanisms cannot be excluded.
productDetails.Warning1: Semaglutide should not be used in patients with type 1 diabetes mellitus or for the treatment of diabetic ketoacidosis. Semaglutide is not a substitute for insulin. Diabetic ketoacidosis has been reported in insulin-dependent patients whom had rapid discontinuation or dose reduction of insulin when treatment with a GLP-1 receptor agonist is started .
productDetails.Warning2: Use of GLP-1 receptor agonists may be associated with gastrointestinal adverse reactions. This should be considered when treating patients, with impaired renal function as nausea, vomiting, and diarrhoea may cause dehydration which could cause a deterioration of renal function .
productDetails.Warning3: Acute pancreatitis has been observed with the use of GLP-1 receptor agonists. Patients should be informed of the characteristic symptoms of acute pancreatitis. If pancreatitis is suspected, semaglutide should be discontinued; if confirmed, semaglutide should not be restarted. Caution should be exercised in patients with a history of pancreatitis.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Concomitant Use with an Insulin Secretagogue (e.g., Sulfonylurea) or with Insulin : The risk of hypoglycemia is increased when it is used in combination with insulin secretagogues (e.g., sulfonylureas) or insulin. The risk of hypoglycemia may be lowered by a reduction in the dose of sulfonylurea (or other concomitantly administered insulin secretagogues) or insulin .

productDetails.HowItWorks: This medicine contains two active substances, isoconazole nitrate and diflucortolone valerate. Isoconazole nitrate treats fungal diseases of the skin and diflucortolone valerate suppresses inflammation of the skin and soothes complaints such as itching, burning and pain .
productDetails.Indication: It is used to treat fungal infections of the skin where inflammation (redness, swelling, soreness) is also a problem.
productDetails.SideEffects: Common: may affect up to 1 in 10 people : Skin irritation or burning feeling at the application site . Uncommon: May affect up to 1 in 100 people : Redness (erythema) or dryness at the application site . Stretch marks (skin striae) . Not known: Frequency cannot be estimated from the available data , itching (pruritus) or blisters (vesicles) at the application site , blurred vision .
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Do not use if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to isoconazole nitrate or diflucortolone-valerate or any of the other ingredients of this medicine ,  have skin lesions in the area to be treated which are associated with a tuberculosis or syphilis infection, have a viral infection e.g. herpes, shingles or chicken-pox (varicella, herpes zoster),  have a chronic skin inflammation of the face (rosacea), skin inflammation around the mouth (perioral dermatitis) or a skin reaction following vaccination in the area to be treated.
productDetails.Dosage: It should be applied twice daily to the diseased areas of skin. Stop using when the skin conditions have improved. In general, the duration of treatment must not exceed 2 weeks. OR As directed by your physician .
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: Do not allow to come into contact with the eyes when applying it to your face. Extensive application of glucocorticoid-containing topical medicines to large areas of the body or for prolonged periods of time, in particular under occlusion (e.g. diapers, dressings) increases the risk of side effects.
productDetails.Warning1: There is a risk of developing an eye condition called glaucoma if you apply cream covered by a dressing, in large amounts, over a long period of time or if it is applied to the area around the eyes.
productDetails.Warning2: If it is applied to the genital areas, some of its ingredients may cause damage to latex products . Therefore, these may no longer be effective as contraception or as protection against sexually transmitted diseases such as HIV infection. Talk to your doctor or pharmacist, if you require more information.
productDetails.Warning3: Regular hygienic measures are essential for successful treatment to avoid renewed infection.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Please tell your doctor or pharmacist if you are taking or have recently taken any other medicines, including medicines obtained without a prescription. Interactions with other medicines are not known so far.

productDetails.HowItWorks: Ivy leaf contains saponins which are considered to have mucolytic, spasmolytic and bronchodilatory effects. It contains Ivy Leaf Extract and is a purely herbal remedy with antitussive and expectorant action. It relieves cough and typical complaints associated with bronchitis: increased formation of viscous mucus, shortness of breath and irritation of the throat.
productDetails.Indication: Used in : Supports and strengthens healthy lung function. - Acts as a bronchodilator, cough suppressant, expectorant, mucolytic and spasmolytic agent. - Relieves chest congestion, soothes the mucus membrane of bronchial walls and restores normal breathing.
productDetails.SideEffects: It may cause nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal and epigastric (in the upper middle part of the abdomen) pain in some patients. Consult a healthcare practitioner if you have any side effects or if your symptoms persist or worsen.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Hypersensitivity to any of the ingredient(s).
productDetails.Dosage: Children below 6 years : 2.5mL, 2 times daily ; Children 6-12 years : 5mL, 2 times daily ; Children above 12 years and Adults : 5mL, 3 times daily . For children under the age of one year, please consult your healthcare practitioner.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: Pregnant and nursing women should consult a healthcare practitioner prior to taking this syrup.
productDetails.Warning1: Do not use if you are allergic to Ivy Leaf. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose.
productDetails.Warning2: If dyspnea, fever or purulent sputum occurs, consult a healthcare practitioner immediately .
productDetails.Warning3: In case of a missed dose, do not double the dose; simply continue to take next dose as per next schedule.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Simultaneous use with other medicines is not recommended without medical advice.

productDetails.HowItWorks: By increasing and prolonging active incretin levels, Sitagliptin increases insulin release and decreases glucagon levels in the circulation in a glucose-dependent manner. It is a biguanide with antihyperglycemic effects, lowering both basal and postprandial plasma glucose. It does not stimulate insulin secretion and therefore does not produce hypoglycemia.
productDetails.Indication: It is indicated as: - Initial therapy in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus to improve glycemic control when diet and exercise do not provide adequate glycemic control.  As an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus inadequately controlled on Metformin HCl or Sitagliptin alone or in patients already being treated with the combination of Sitagliptin and Metformin HCl.
productDetails.SideEffects: Common: nausea.Uncommon: somnolence, diarrhea, upper abdominal pain and blood glucose decreased.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: The combination of Sitagliptin and Metformin HCl is contraindicated in:- Patients with type 1 diabetes. -Patients with known hypersensitivity to Sitagliptin, Metformin HCl or any other component of the product. - Acute or chronic metabolic acidosis , including ketoacidosis, with or without coma.
productDetails.Dosage: For patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus, whose hyperglycemic is inadequately controlled with diet and exercise alone, the recommended starting dose of (Sitagliptin + Metformin HCl) is 50mg of Sitagliptin + 500mg of Metformin HCl twice daily. Patients may be titrated upto 50mg Sitagliptin + 1000mg of Metformin HCl twice daily. The dosage of (Sitagliptin + Metformin HCl) should be individualized on the basis of patient’s current regimen, effectiveness and tolerability while not exceeding the maximum recommended daily dose of 100mg Sitagliptin.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: Sitagliptin+Metformin HCl are known to be substantially excreted by the kidney.Metformin HCl-related lactic acidosis increases with the degree of insufficiency of renal function, therefore, serum creatinine concentrations should be determined regularly.
productDetails.Warning1: Since impaired hepatic function has been associated with some cases of lactic acidosis, Sitagliptin+Metformin HCl should generally be avoided in patients with clinical or laboratory evidence of hepatic disease.
productDetails.Warning2: Patient receiving Sitagliptin+Metformin HCl in combination with a sulphonylurea or with insulin may be at risk for hypoglycemia. Therefore, a reduction in the dose of the sulphonylurea or insulin may be necessary.
productDetails.Warning3: After initiation of Sitagliptin, patients should be observed carefully for signs and symptoms of pancreatitis. If pancreatitis is suspected, Sitagliptin should promptly be discontinued and appropriate management should be initiated.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Digoxin , Furosemide , Nifedipine , Cationic drugs (e.g., amiloride, digoxin, morphine, procainamide, quinidine, quinine ranitidine, triamterene, trimethoprim, or vancomycin) ,  thiazides and other diuretics, corticosteroids, phenothiazines, thyroid products, estrogens, oral contraceptives, phenytoin, nicotinic acid, sympathomimetics, calcium channel blocking drugs, and isoniazid.

productDetails.HowItWorks: It is a skin ointment, which contains the active ingredients polymyxin B sulphate and bacitracin zinc. Polymyxin B sulphate and bacitracin zinc are antibacterials. Similar to other local anesthetics, the mechanism of action of lignocaine for local or regional anesthesia is by reversible blockade of nerve fibre impulse propagation .
productDetails.Indication: It is used to help prevent infection of the skin following: • Minor burns • A skin graft being taken • Surgery • Accidental cuts, scratches or scrapes.
productDetails.SideEffects: Nephrotoxicity , sensitization.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Do not use if you: • Are allergic (hypersensitive) to polymyxin B sulphate, bacitracin zinc, other similar antibiotics, or any of the other ingredients . An allergic reaction may include rash, itching, difficulty breathing or swelling of the face, lips, throat or tongue.
productDetails.Dosage: Adults & Children : Apply sparingly two or more times daily OR As directed by your physician.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: If a large amount is absorbed into the body it may cause damage to the nerves and kidneys. Therefore, if a large area of your skin is treated with this ointment your doctor should monitor your kidney function.
productDetails.Warning1: Long-term use may cause an increased growth of micro-organisms (germs) that are not affected by this ointment, such as fungi, and this could lead to an infection.
productDetails.Warning2: Take special care and speak to your doctor if you have a child using large amounts .
productDetails.Warning3: Take special care and speak to your doctor if you have a kidney disorder .
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Please tell your doctor or pharmacist if you are taking, or have recently taken, any other medicines, including medicines obtained without a prescription .

productDetails.HowItWorks: It is a medicine that consists of Polyethylene glycol and Propylene glycol. It is a lubricating agent used for the temporary relief of symptoms such as burning, irritation, stinging, grittiness, foreign body sensation, etc., caused due to dryness of the eyes or other environmental factors.
productDetails.Indication: It is used for dry eyes.
productDetails.SideEffects: Redness of the eye , Blurred vision , Eye pain , Changes in vision.
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Avoid using Eye Drops if you are allergic to it. Contact your doctor immediately if you notice any symptoms such as skin rashes, itching/swelling, dizziness, breathing difficulty, etc.
productDetails.Dosage: Adults : 1-2 drops as required. OR As directed by your physician.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: Avoid using Lubricant Eye Drops if the solution is cloudy or the colour has changed .
productDetails.Warning1: If you experience any symptoms such as eye pain, changes in vision, continued redness or irritation, worsening of the condition or persistence of symptoms for more than 72 hours after using Lubricant Eye Drops, contact your doctor for further consultation.
productDetails.Warning2: Eye Drops should be used for external application only on your eyes. Ensure that only the affected eye is treated with Lubricant Eye Drops. Avoid direct contact with your nose and mouth. Wash thoroughly with water in case of accidental contact.
productDetails.Warning3: To avoid contamination, do not touch the tip of the container to any surface. Close the cap after Lubricant Eye Drops. Appropriate precautions should be taken to prevent the contamination of the container and the medicine.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: Ask your physician or pharmacist for any drug interaction.

productDetails.HowItWorks: It works by blocking a certain natural substance (histamine) that your body makes during an allergic reaction.
productDetails.Indication: This medicine is used to relieve: • Symptoms of hayfever and other allergies such as sneezing, runny nose and burning, itchy eyes • Symptoms of skin allergies such as rash, itching or urticaria (hives) .
productDetails.SideEffects: If you experience any of the following, stop taking this medicine and talk to your doctor: Confusion , Hallucinations , Abnormal liver function tests , Rapid heartbeat , Loss of consciousness . Other effects which may occur include: Common (affecting 1 in 100 to 1 in 10 people): Headache and dizziness , Drowsiness or tiredness , Restlessness , Dry mouth, sore throat , Upset stomach, diarrhoea, nausea , Runny nose . Uncommon (affecting 1 in 1000 to 1 in 100 people): Agitation , Weakness , Malaise , Pins & needles , Itching , Rash , Abdominal pain .
productDetails.WhenNotToUse: Do not take if you: • Are allergic (hypersensitive) to cetirizine dihydrochloride or any of the other ingredients in the medicine. • Have serious kidney problems .
productDetails.Dosage: Adults : 10mg once daily. Children : 1-2yr , 250mcg/kg twice daily ; 2-6yr , 5mg once daily , alternatively 2.5mg twice daily; 7-12yr, 10mg once daily , alternatively 5mg twice daily , over 12yr , same as adult. Always consult your doctor or pharmacist for dose adjustments.
productDetails.StorageYesOrNo: Store this medicine at room temperature, away from direct light and heat.
productDetails.Precautions: f you are due to have an allergy test, ask your doctor if you should stop taking cetirizine dihydrochloride oral solution for several days before testing. This medicine may affect your allergy test results.
productDetails.Warning1: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before taking this medicine if you: • Have epilepsy or are at risk of convulsions. • Have problems passing urine (like spinal cord problems, prostate or bladder problems) .
productDetails.Warning2: Tests have shown that this medicine does not cause drowsiness in the vast majority of people using it. Therefore it will not normally affect your ability to drive or operate machinery. However there may be very rare exceptions and if you experience dizziness, nausea or drowsiness, do not drive or operate machinery.
productDetails.Warning3: This product contains lactose. If you have been told by your doctor that you have an intolerance to some sugars, contact your doctor before taking this medicine.
productDetails.PregnancyCategory: Always consult your physician before using any medicine.
productDetails.DrugInteractions: CNS suppresants , alcohol

In the event of persistent symptoms such as fever, shortness of breath, haemoptysis, consult a healthcare practitioner immediately .
